title: Omnipitent_Tools
description: This project adds omnipitent tools that are really powerful.
body:
This mod adds tons of powerful weapons and items.
This powerful items include The Destroyer which despawns and deals kill damage to entitys you hit.
you can right click the Destroyer to make it shoot projectiles that despawns entitys it his and summon lightning and explodes.you  can also right click on a block to make a 21 by 21 hole(destroys bedrock too)
The next item is the lightning sword it deals 15 damage and summons lightning.
There is more like the omnipitent pickaxe that when right clicked shoots a pickaxe projectile that mines a 11 by 11 area on the place of the pickaxe projectile and another item called the destroyer crossbow that can shoot 5 projectile at once and create a massive explosion and can despawn and kill entitys and summons lightning.
